title: Parallelising Huffman decoding and x86 disassembly by synchronising non-self-synchronising prefix codes
relevance: Primary source for the sync-point convergence method. Provides implementation code and preliminary 25% speedup result on Apple M1 for DEFLATE.

title: Self-synchronization of Huffman codes
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory
relevance: Theoretical analysis of Huffman code self-synchronization properties, characterizing when and how fast prefix codes resynchronize.

title: Massively Parallel Huffman Decoding on GPUs
relevance: Uses self-synchronization property for GPU-parallel Huffman decoding, achieving 10x speedup over CPU baseline.

title: On the construction of maximal prefix-synchronized codes
relevance: Constructs prefix codes with maximal synchronization properties, directly relevant to designing codes optimized for parallel decode.
